caseName: Township of Avon v. Detroit United Railway
caseNameFull: Township of Avon v. Detroit United Railway
summary: Error to the Supreme Court of the State of Michigan.
attorneys: Mr. Glenn C. Gillespie for plaintiffs in erro\\, Mr. Elliott G. Stevenson and Mr. William L. Carpenter for defendant in error.

opinions.text:
Per Curiam. Mr. Glenn C. Gillespie for plaintiffs in erro\ Mr. Elliott G. Stevenson and Mr. William L. Carpenter for defendant in error.

Dismissed for want of jurisdiction upon the authority of Pawhuska v. Pawhuska Oil & Gas Co., 250 U. S. 394, 397; Hunter v. Pittsburgh, 207 U. S. 161, 178; Kansas City v. Public Service Commission of Missouri, 250 U. S. 652; Hillsboro v. Public Service Commission of Oregon, point (3), 255 U. S. 562; Groesbeck v. Detroit United Railway, ante, 609.
